components.name: TiltCardLayer
components.doc: A part of the card that floats above its face, so it shifts against the background as the card leans.

types.name: TiltCardProps
types.doc: A card that leans in 3D toward the cursor, with a soft glare that follows it, and springs back flat when the cursor leaves. It stays still for touch and pen input and when the person prefers reduced motion.

members.name: children
members.doc: Card content. Wrap parts in `TiltCardLayer` to float them above the card face.

members.name: maxTilt
members.doc: Largest lean in degrees, reached at the card's edges.

members.name: hoverScale
members.doc: How much the card grows while hovered. `1` keeps its size.

members.name: perspective
members.doc: Viewing distance in px. Smaller values exaggerate the depth.

members.name: glare
members.doc: Shows the highlight that follows the cursor.

members.name: glareOpacity
members.doc: Strongest opacity of the glare, from 0 to 1.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the card flat and ignores the cursor.

members.name: onTiltChange
members.doc: Reports the lean as the cursor moves: x and y from -1 to 1, both 0 when the card rests.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.

members.name: style
members.doc: Inline styles for the root element, for sizes and CSS variables.

members.name: children
members.doc: Content that floats above the card face.

members.name: depth
members.doc: Distance above the card face in px. Higher layers shift more as the card leans.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.
